conclusions: Preparation admits only this current macOS Native-tag checkout and matching same-job source/run restored-native record. Actual Mach-O device-platform inspection and deep original codesign verification are required.

Only allowed executable/profile/CodeResources changes are permitted while producing the complete controlled input. Separate small JSON and streamed full IPA keep existing512MiB and component/code bounds; unsupported full layouts fail. Original entitlements including original AppGroup, Apple-signin and CloudKit are retained. No authority or installation is inferred.

Device project overlay and the exact owned synthetic Google configuration restore through finally on success/failure. Existing Simulator preparation then replaces only manifest-owned runtime payload and owns its existing source overlay. Resource hashes and source/overlay facts are rechecked before and after the one required Swift selection.

The runner selects exactly one noargument method, retains real command exit/deadline and actual xcresult summary/tests exports even on failure, and gates1 definition/1 execution on exactly one device with0 failures/skips. Zero, wrong, duplicate, failed or skipped actual case trees reject. No inherited old minimal or source-only result is accepted.

Workflow upload adds only S3 JSON/log patterns. The complete IPA, built app, private producer directory, Keychain/P12/private key and S3 raw result-bundle tree are excluded. Public metadata contains hashes/certificates, not an archive body. Existing Native/MainJS/cold selections and prior budgets are otherwise unchanged.

Default minimal producer AST and the shared existing CMS/codesign callbacks are exact. Source-ready evidence is four actually passed portable methods and four Python syntax sources plus YAML parsing, not a real iPhoneOS build, codesign or production full-package execution.
limits: 106 explicit conservative owner/build/notice inputs are not a claim to enumerate every Xcode/SwiftPM/JVM transitive compilation dependency. Root must derive the final coherent compilation union; Java/JAR binary identity is also checked by existing actual native/runtime provenance owners.

An ephemeral CI failure can leave unneeded device-resource data in the isolated checkout, while tracked project/owned Google configuration restoration is enforced. This does not claim OS termination can run finally.
This reviewer did not rerun the four portable guards, execute the modified scripts, compile Swift or invoke any Apple tool. The independent peer review of the authored Swift source is separate.
